node.title: XR nongeneric support-only exponential-width fence
node.statement: At each of the six clean-rate roots, there is an abstract family of A-subsets satisfying the exact joint-explanation support cap |Y intersect Y'|<=K-1 and containing more than 16n^3 members. Pairing 2A coordinates converts a binary Gilbert code of length A and distance H=h+1 into such a family; H/A<=1/16 gives size greater than 2^(5A/8). These supports are not claimed to be realizable RS explanations. The result proves that pre-terminal XR closure cannot use pairwise support packing alone and must retain algebraic realization or actual-slope ownership.
